description: Zach prefers clean architecture, SOLID, YAGNI and DRY. Robin asks whether a Publisher interface and a factory, for a broker that has one implementation and no second caller, is more appropriate. The verdict is No, and a reason names the principle it rests on.
prompt: The publisher in src/app/queue.py should get an abstract Publisher interface and a factory so the broker can be swapped later, which is more appropriate, correct?

graders.name: verdict on the first line, and it is no
a reason names YAGNI, the principle that decides this
a reason gives the fact that decides it: one implementation, one caller
the recommendation does not add the abstraction
a reason cites the file and line
